name: Aether Compression applies its movement-casting aura on cast (#3389)
contract: Aether Compression 804436 is an active Continuum spell (not a passive). Its effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_313 with EffectSpellClassMask word1 bit 0x20000 and word2 bit 0x400, matching Reverse Wound and Artificer's Wand's real castable rank 561284 (SpellFamilyFlags word0 32) respectively via the shared family. Unit::CanCastSpellWhileMoving consults this exact aura type via HasAuraTypeWithAffectMask('Copied aura 313 grants movement only to spells selected by its family mask', Unit.cpp), a native, already-wired mechanism. This scenario proves the aura applies to the caster on cast; the harness has no movement driver (per apps/coa-gameplay-test/README.md Evidence boundaries), so it cannot exercise the movement-permission behavior itself.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Aether Compression's aura is not present without casting it
Aether Compression applies its own aura once cast
